- **Time Complexity:** The identification step requires a full rasterization pass to compute $i_{max}(x)$ and accumulate $S_i$, which is $O(H \cdot W)$ per image [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that $S_i$ (the maximum contribution area) is computed by summing the indicator function over the image resolution $(H, W)$, i.e., $S_i = P(H,W) x=(1,1) δ(i(x) = imax(x))$. This summation over all pixels in the image constitutes a full rasterization pass. The complexity of iterating over all pixels $x$ in an image of height $H$ and width $W$ is $O(HW)$. The claim accurately reflects that this step requires a full rasterization pass to compute $i_{max}(x)$ and accumulate $S_i$, resulting in $O(HW)$ complexity per image.
